subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, leaving channel-selective reply routing to a separate API or policy follow-up?
rationale: The code-confirmed gap is narrow, but letting the model choose or suppress delivery channels would affect channel routing and message-delivery contracts beyond prompt reconstruction.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` while leaving delivery routing unchanged.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep or open a separate follow-up for a maintainer-approved API/prompt direction around channel-selective replies before changing delivery behavior.

options.title: Reject Model-Selected Routing
options.body: Document that reply routing remains host-controlled and close the selective-routing portion while still fixing the prompt metadata gap.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` while leaving delivery routing unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the shared command prompt bundle and already framed the narrow prompt-metadata scope versus selective-routing follow-up in the issue discussion.
